mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I want to renovate just one room in my house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with a clear scope: what room is changing, what problems you want solved, and which finishes or fixtures you want replaced. For a single-room renovation in the Denver area, a contractor or designer will usually review the space, confirm what is structurally possible, and then build a plan before work starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by defining the room, your goals, and your budget. Then schedule a site review so the scope, design, and any permit needs can be confirmed before work begins.
